As of right now, you can only schedule reminders in days or weeks, and can check off reminder alerts … I flagged this need to the team, and they invited me on a feedback call and made value of that time. 

I’d be interested in how the app evolves in the next year or so. With such a dedicated and curious team, I can see it becoming one of the best plant apps out there!

Review of Plant Identifier App. In today's world where nature and technology intersect, the Plant Identifier app has emerged as an invaluable tool for plant enthusiasts, gardeners, and nature lovers alike. As someone who has always had a keen interest in botany but lacked formal training, I was eager to put this app to the test. Here's my detailed review based on my experience.

#### User Interface (UI) and Design
The first thing that struck me about the Plant Identifier app was its clean and intuitive interface. The design is user-friendly, making navigation seamless even for those who are not tech-savvy. The layout is aesthetically pleasing, with vibrant colors that reflect the beauty of nature. The home screen features a prominent search bar, encouraging users to dive right in.

#### Functionality
The core function of the app is, of course, plant identification. Users can take a photo of a plant or upload one from their gallery, and within seconds, the app provides a list of possible matches along with detailed information about each plant. The accuracy of the identification is impressive, I tried several different plants, from common houseplants to more obscure species, and the app consistently delivered reliable results.

Beyond identification, the app offers a wealth of information on each plant, including care tips, habitat, and common uses. This feature is particularly beneficial for beginners looking to expand their knowledge and improve their gardening skills. Additionally, the app includes a plant database that is regularly updated, ensuring users have access to the latest information.

#### Community and Social Features
One of the standout features of the Plant Identifier app is its community aspect. Users can share their findings, ask questions, and discuss various plant-related topics in a dedicated forum. This sense of community fosters engagement and learning, making it not just an app but a platform for plant enthusiasts to connect and share their passion

#### Pricing
While the app is free to download, it does offer a premium version with additional features, such as advanced identification tools and an ad-free experience. I found the free version to be quite robust for casual users, but the premium upgrade may be worth it for avid gardeners and professionals.

#### Conclusion
Overall, the Plant Identifier app is a must-have for anyone interested in plants, whether you're a novice gardener or a seasoned botanist. Its combination of accuracy, ease of use, and community engagement creates a rich experience for users. The app has certainly enhanced my ability to identify and care for various plants, and I look forward to exploring more of its features in the future. Highly recommended! 🌿📱

- Don't have the garden info input be something that automatically comes up (ever). Have it be an option...
- First thing up should be a question if you want a tutorial on how to use and the features of app.
- Don't ask for a review until a number of hours have been logged using the app. And have respectful the "no thanks" button
